mapper.sql: CASE WHEN u.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE LEAST(GREATEST((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(${on}, u.birth_date))::int / 10) * 10, 10), 70)::text END
mapper.insert: WITH enr AS ( SELECT e.course_id, AS band FROM tb_enrollments e JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE e.applied_at >= #{since} AND e.status NOT IN ('REJECTED', 'CANCELLED', 'WITHDRAWN') AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED') ), vw AS ( SELECT v.course_id, v.user_id, AS band FROM tb_course_views v JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = v.course_id LEFT JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = v.user_id WHERE v.view_date >= #{sinceDate} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED') ), events AS ( SELECT course_id, 'ALL' AS seg, '*' AS seg_key, 1 AS e, 0 AS v FROM enr UNION ALL SELECT course_id, 'AGE_BAND', band, 1, 0 FROM enr WHERE band IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT course_id, 'ALL', '*', 0, 1 FROM vw UNION ALL SELECT course_id, 'AGE_BAND', band, 0, 1 FROM vw WHERE band IS NOT NULL ) INSERT INTO tb_course_popularity ( course_id, segment_type, segment_key, window_days, enrollment_count, view_count, score, computed_at ) SELECT course_id, seg, seg_key, #{windowDays}, SUM(e), SUM(v), SUM(e) * #{enrollmentWeight} + SUM(v) * #{viewWeight}, #{now} FROM events GROUP BY course_id, seg, seg_key
